# Log of pipeline changes made for the prior experiments (to clean up once a pipeline is chosen)

Nothing tracked by git in `refactoring/` was modified: `git status` shows only the new files below, and `testing.py` runs
unchanged. Reverting an item means deleting the lines it names (or the file); every setting has a default that reproduces
the previous behaviour, so the round-one/two/three runs are unaffected by the later additions.

## Core integration (rounds 1-3): OTE OPD generated by DPS-Adam inside pyFLIP's loop
- `priors/model.py`, `priors/schedule.py`, `priors/dpsadam.py` (`DPSPhase`, `DPSAdamOPD`): copies of the InverseBench parts.
- `priors/stages.py` (`prior_stages`): `default_stages` plus `fit_ote_in_science`.
- `priors/plots.py`: metrics/figures. `testing_priors.py`: the integration. `testing_priors_plot.py`: same plus logging and the `VARIANTS` table.

## Round 4 (2026-10-20): Lyot-plane OPD regularization and flux refit (experimental)
- `priors/grids.py` (new file): `CoarseOPDGrid` (band-limited Lyot grid) and `FluxScale` (star flux x exp(log_scale), fitted by gradient).
- `priors/stages.py`, top of `prior_stages`: the star position gradient is zeroed at iterations 600 and 3500 (the stage
  cutoffs), where `default_stages` zeroes nothing. Without it a poorly fitting run (frozen or drift Lyot) kicks the star
  position by tens of learning rates at 3500 (see `outputs/round4_kicked/`). Harmless for the other runs; keep or port to `default_stages`.
- `priors/plots.py`: `model_fields` ignores the `wfe_offsets` entries of the saved states (so coarse grids / priors load);
  `fig_planet` has a flux-factor panel.
- `testing_priors_plot.py`: settings `lyot_mode` ('free' = testing.py), `lyot_coarse_nodes`, `lyot_prior_start/end`,
  `fit_flux` (False = testing.py), `flux_lr`; the `FluxScale` swap after the wavefront is built; the Lyot module swap block
  (`lyot_prior`, `lyot_grid`); the optimizer-group edits for 'frozen', the Lyot prior and the flux; `lyot_prior.step(i)` in the
  loop; the flux-gradient zeroing after `hardcoded_match_flux`; `flux_factors`/`flux_ratios` logging; `save_state` folding
  the flux scale; the round-four `VARIANTS`.

## Round 5 (2026-10-21): strictly band-limited Lyot grid, Lyot grid learning rate
- `priors/grids.py`: `CoarseOPDGrid(upsample='fourier')` (zero-padded spectrum cut to a disk: nothing above n_nodes/2 cycles
  per array; 'bicubic' = round four, which leaked 15% of a fitted 24-node layer above 18 cycles).
- `testing_priors_plot.py`: settings `lyot_coarse_upsample`, `lyot_grid_lr` (own optimizer group when not None; note the cosine
  scheduler's `eta_min` 4e-9 pulls a smaller rate up towards 4e-9 over the run, as it does for `ote_grid_lr`); round-five `VARIANTS`.
- `testing_priors_plot.py`: settings `lyot_sci_prior_start/end` (second DPS window of the Lyot drift prior on the science frame).
- `priors/plots.py`: edge-free Lyot layer metric (`lyot_layer_hf`: the fitted layer only, band-passed on the full array) in the Lyot
  figure and the summary table (`python priors/plots.py --table ...`). The metric logged during the runs (`lyot_hf_rms_nm`, total
  Lyot OPD masked by the stop) has a floor of ~40% of the layer's rms for any smooth layer, from the stop edge.

## Round 6 (2026-10-21)
- `testing_priors_plot.py`: setting `lyot_grid_frozen_until` (Lyot grid gradient zeroed before it; one line in the loop before the
  stage handler); round-six `VARIANTS`.

## Round 7 (2026-10-21)
- `testing_priors_plot.py`: settings `lyot_guidance_scale`, `lyot_sci_guidance_scale` (the Lyot latents get one optimizer group per
  DPS window instead of `lyot_prior.param_group`); round-seven `VARIANTS` (`w_*`).

## To clean up at the end

  uses it; delete the unused `VARIANTS`; decide whether the position-gradient zeroing in `priors/stages.py` goes into
